title: Switch to Chat / Switch to Terminal in the tab's right-click and the chat's ⋮ (user 2026-11-20): a terminal running a Claude Code session, its tab's right-click, the chat it switches to, the chat's ⋮, and back; light then dark. Needs --whole-host for the menu shots

claude.description: Synthetic capture harness (Toggle Terminal and Chat tours)

steps.title: Seed: a short Claude Code transcript, and the terminal reports its session (agent hook SessionStart)
cmux:
clear; mkdir -p "$HOME/switch-menu" && cd "$HOME/switch-menu" && C=$(pwd -P); cmux setup trust | tr , "
" | grep -m1 state; S=5a7e5a7e-0000-4000-8000-000000002000; D="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/projects/$(printf %s "$C" | tr -c "A-Za-z0-9" -)"; mkdir -p "$D" && python3 -c 'import json,sys;p,c,s=sys.argv[1:4];u=lambda i:"5a7e0000-0000-4000-9000-%012d"%i;open(p,"w").write("".join(json.dumps({"type":("user","assistant")[i%2],"uuid":u(i),"parentUuid":u(i-1) if i else None,"sessionId":s,"timestamp":"2026-11-01T%02d:%02d:%02d.000Z"%(i//3600,i//60%60,i%60),"cwd":c,"message":{"role":"user","content":"Turn %d: how does pane %d keep its place when the view swaps?"%(i//2,i%7)} if i%2==0 else {"id":"msg_%d"%i,"type":"message","role":"assistant","model":"claude-opus-5-5","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Answer %d: both views stay mounted.

- the terminal keeps its scrollback
- the chat keeps its offset

`swap %d`"%(i//2,i)}],"stop_reason":"end_turn"}})+"
" for i in range(12)))' "$D/$S.jsonl" "$C" "$S" && seq -f "scrollback %g of 3000: terminal and chat swap bench" 1 3000 && echo TRANSCRIPT-READY && cmux agent hook emit --source claude --event SessionStart --payload-json "{"session_id":"$S"}" && echo HOOK-SENT

steps.title: Light: the terminal tab's right-click leads with Switch to Chat
Light: the chat's ⋮ leads with Switch to terminal
Dark: the terminal tab's right-click leads with Switch to Chat
Dark: the chat's ⋮ leads with Switch to terminal
